x: A hands-on guide that teaches Process GPT step by step from scratch: describe a company's routine work in words to turn it into a process, teach AI agent colleagues the company's documents, and attach business rules as decision tables. What is Process GPT Process GPT is an open-source platform for business processes and AI agents together . The order of the work and who does each part are defined in BPMN, the international standard notation, and each step is done by a person or handed to an AI agent. You don't need to know how to draw BPMN. Describe the work you want in the chat, and Process GPT creates the flow diagram and the input forms. This tutorial follows the story of Hanbit Office , an office furniture company. Character Role Jinyoung Jang Sales team lead. The person you play in this tutorial, and the Process GPT admin Minji Kim Sales representative. Takes customer requests and writes proposals Seoyeon Park Finance officer. Approves high-value quotes Hanbit Office Quote Advisor An AI colleague that reads the price list and writes draft quotes (you build it in Chapter 9) Getting started — Install Process GPT and look around the screens. Process basics — Describe the "Sales Proposal Creation" work in chat to turn it into a process, look inside the resulting definition (flow diagram, roles, forms), and manage its versions. Add colleagues to the org chart, run the process and handle the tasks, and go through an approve/reject gateway. AI agents — Upload the product price list to the Knowledge Base so answers are based on it, then build an agent colleague that writes draft quotes and chat with it. Teach it a quote layout with a skill, and use the quote approval policy to create a process that includes agents. Tools and rules — Connect a document tool through MCP to fill the company Word template with a quote, and turn the volume discount criteria into a decision table (DMN) through chat and attach it to an agent. Analysis and improvement — See step times and bottlenecks from run history, and set objectives and KPIs on the strategy board. Operations — Bring in colleagues and change the display language and settings. Final project — Build Hanbit Office A/S intake from start to finish yourself. Process GPT shows a draft with the steps, owners and flow, gets your confirmation, then creates and saves a process definition with a BPMN flow diagram and input forms. Why make it a process Whenever a customer asks for a proposal, the Hanbit Office sales team works in the same order. They take down what the customer asks for, and a sales representative reads it, writes the proposal and sends it. Today this goes back and forth by email and messenger, so you have to ask to find out how far a request has got, and when the person in charge changes, the notes sometimes get lost. Turning this order into a process changes things like this. Case by case As a process People remember who does what next The steps and owners are written in the definition Notes are scattered across email and messenger They stay in the input form set for each step You have to ask to know the progress The progress of each case (instance) is visible on screen Process GPT stores processes as BPMN . BPMN is the international standard notation that draws a workflow as steps, gateways and owner bands (lanes). You don't need to know how to draw it. Describe it in words, and Process GPT draws it. Try it 1 — Pick an agent and describe the work In the chat box on the home screen (the pencil icon at the top of the sidebar), click Deep Agent ▾ and switch to Basic Agent . Picking an agent — Basic Agent, Deep Agent, Codex Why Basic Agent Deep Agent can also create processes, and it builds skills and agents along with them. But it takes several minutes because it works through many steps on its own, and in the current version it sometimes ends with "Something went wrong while putting the process files together, so I'm holding the result back." While you're learning, we recommend the short and reliable Basic Agent . Describe the process you want in the chat box. Say who does what at each step, and say that you need forms. Its title is "Shall I create the process from this draft?". It lists the process name, the steps and the role that owns each one, the flow, and open questions. The draft — process name “Sales Proposal Creation”, steps 1. [Customer] Submit request · 2. [Sales Representative] Write and send proposal, the flow, and open questions (None) What to check : two steps with their owners (Customer, Sales Representative) and a flow from the customer to the sales representative to the end ("Customer(Submit request) → Sales Representative(Write and send proposal) → End" in our run).
